task.title: To mark a field as Smart

step.cmd: Insert the field into your template by following the steps in Inserting Fields in a Template.
In the Templates pane, go to Work and click Fields.
The Fields page shows the list of all the fields present in your template. Use the Search Field box to search for a field by keyword.
Select a field from the list and click the Settings icon () next to the field name.
In the Properties pane, click the toggle for the Smart Field attribute to enable it.

note.p: To remove the smartness property of a field, you can slide the Smart Field attribute toggle to off position (greyed out).
